recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce Condition.dueTo children in core; any future change to the moved condition-dueTo extension should be handled in the FHIR Extension Pack.
issue_request: FHIR-5408 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Patient Care ballot issue requesting Condition.dueTo.codeableConcept be renamed to Condition.dueTo.code because codeableConcept was a poor attribute name and likely a typographic error.
initial_application: Historical git-svn commit db55db7414cc49a9bd93c668c9fd19c3de26fccf, matching Jira's svn ~4750 note, changed the Condition spreadsheets and related DAF/QICore Condition profile spreadsheets from Condition.dueTo.codeableConcept to Condition.dueTo.code, including the old dueto-code search parameter expression.
additional_context: FHIR-5408 was discovered while tracing FHIR-5409 because it is the sibling typo correction for the same old Condition relationship model. Later Published issues FHIR-7620 and FHIR-7621 moved Condition.dueTo and Condition.occurredFollowing from core Condition elements into extensions, and FHIR-10102 later changed those extensions from separate code/detail children to a CodeableConcept or Reference value[x] choice. The current core Condition StructureDefinition no longer contains Condition.dueTo; it only references the condition-dueTo extension from Condition.evidence guidance. The current condition-dueTo definition is in the FHIR Extension Pack and uses Extension.value[x] with CodeableConcept and Reference types.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The historical rename was applied, later WG decisions removed the old core child representation, and current source searches found no remaining obsolete Condition.dueTo.codeableConcept path.

related_jiras.note: Sibling ballot issue for the same Condition relationship typo pattern on Condition.occurredFollowing.codeableConcept; this was the seed investigation.
Patient Care later decided dueTo and occurredFollowing should become extensions rather than core Condition elements.
Later adjustment to the moved extension reference child naming.
Later decision replacing separate dueTo/occurredFollowing code and detail children with a CodeableConcept or Reference value[x] choice.
